provenance.revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: isolated production parallax formation for a side-view 2D exploration platformer; one near-depth lower-wall and rubble companion layer; landscape aspect ratio exactly 16:9 (target composition 960:540); output exactly one PNG.

Primary request: Create a single connected ancient catacomb masonry formation designed to overlap neighboring copies by 96 target pixels. Show a broad broken masonry wall with collapsed burial plinths, uneven horizontal stone courses, bone-strewn rubble pockets, and only a few short fractured column bases. The formation must read as one connected environment layer, never as detached props.

Background/matte: Every background pixel must be one perfectly flat, uniform, opaque removal matte of exact hex #FF00FF, RGBA (255, 0, 255, 255). Use no other pinks or magentas and no variation, texture, shading, glow, haze, shadow, or contamination on the matte. This is an opaque chroma-key matte, not transparency.

Silhouette and coverage: The irregular upper contour of the masonry begins within the top 4% of the canvas; the broad lower foundation ends within the bottom 4%. Span nearly the full canvas height with no large empty matte bands above or below. Keep the overall silhouette broad, connected, horizontally layered, and wall-like rather than tower-like. Include a handful of clear internal openings and negative pockets within the formation for gameplay readability.

Mandatory lateral gutters: Reserve the outermost 7% of the canvas on both left and right as completely empty, uniform #FF00FF matte from top edge to bottom edge. Absolutely no subject pixel, debris, shadow, dust, bone, or stray mark may enter either gutter or touch either lateral image edge. Before each gutter, taper the connected masonry into irregular rubble. Seamlessness comes from overlapping these clean gutters by 96 target pixels, not by cutting a solid wall at the canvas boundaries.

Style/medium: crisp hand-authored 16-bit pixel art, production-quality game environment asset; hard pixel edges; no antialiasing, smoothing, painterly blur, gradients, or soft focus. Chunky deliberate pixel clusters, simplified readable forms, strong silhouettes, broad value groups, restrained surface detail.

Lighting/mood: cold subterranean illumination from the upper left, expressed only on the stone-and-bone subject with hard-edged pixel clusters.

Color palette: dark navy and indigo stone shadows, desaturated blue-purple stone midtones, restrained pale blue highlights on bones and select masonry edges. Do not use the exact matte magenta color anywhere in the subject.

Composition: side-view orthographic game-art presentation; broad layered wall mass across the usable center; visually continuous horizontal courses; collapsed plinth slabs embedded into the wall/rubble; small bone pockets integrated into rubble; short broken column bases only; readable internal gaps without breaking the formation into separate islands.

Constraints: exactly one coherent formation; entire canvas filled by either subject or exact matte; nearly full vertical subject extent except for irregular contour pockets; clean opaque chroma-key matte; no text, UI, border, frame, watermark.

Avoid: tall pedestals, full-height columns, arches, ceilings, large repeated skull motifs, characters, standalone props, floor plane, tower-like composition, detached objects, large unused top or bottom bands, visible subject pixels in either lateral gutter, subject touching left or right edge, cut-off solid wall at canvas boundary, painterly rendering, blur, smoothing, antialiasing, semi-transparent pixels, colored matte variation.
